raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a grouped bar chart illustrating “effect” values across language families for six model–layer/variant series. The horizontal axis lists categorical families from left to right as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, with the axis label “family.” The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear numeric scale with labeled ticks at 0, 10, 20, and 30 (bars extend slightly below 0 and up to the mid-30s). Each family has six adjacent bars with error bars (vertical whiskers) in the legend order: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). Approximate bar heights by family are: IE-Baltic shows small positive values around 1–6 across series (e.g., mBERT-L₂ ~2, XLM-L₂ ~1, mBERT-R₂ ~3, XLM-R₂ ~3–4, mBERT-B₂ ~6, XLM-B₂ ~5); IE-Germanic has mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ near ~10 each, mBERT-R₂ near ~0, XLM-R₂ slightly negative (around −1), and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ around ~15; IE-Indic has mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ near ~0, mBERT-R₂ ~20, XLM-R₂ ~18, mBERT-B₂ ~24, and XLM-B₂ ~21; IE-Romance shows mid single-digit values for mBERT-L₂/XLM-L₂/mBERT-R₂ (~4–6), a small value for XLM-R₂ (~1), mBERT-B₂ around ~12–13, and XLM-B₂ around ~6; IE-Slavic has mBERT-L₂ ~10–11 and XLM-L₂ ~9, mBERT-R₂ ~1, XLM-R₂ near ~0, mBERT-B₂ ~17, and XLM-B₂ ~15–16; IE-other has mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ around ~6, mBERT-R₂ near ~0, XLM-R₂ slightly negative (around −1), and both mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ around ~8; Isolate bars cluster near zero to ~2 (mBERT-L₂ slightly below 0, XLM-L₂ near 0, greens around ~1–2, pink/red around ~1–2); Semitic shows mBERT-L₂ ~11, XLM-L₂ ~16, mBERT-R₂ around −2, XLM-R₂ around −1, mBERT-B₂ ~15, and XLM-B₂ ~19–20; Uralic shows small values near ~0–2 across series (pink around ~2, others near ~0–1). Error bars are present on all bars and vary in size, with notably large whiskers on several higher bars (e.g., IE-Indic and Semitic pink/red) and on Semitic blue bars; the bars are not visually sorted and no single bar is specially highlighted beyond color and error bars.
